caption:
# GUI Interface Description

## System Top Bar
- **Left Side**:
  - "Activities" button with a circular icon featuring a gear symbol.
  - "Settings" button with a gear icon.
- **Center**:
  - Date and time display: "Oct 23 00:42".
  - Notification bell icon.
- **Right Side**:
  - Network icon showing "Wired Connected".
  - Sound icon with a volume slider.
  - Power button icon.

## Desktop Environment
- **Background**: Gradient wallpaper transitioning from dark purple to red.
- **Desktop Icons**:
  - A folder icon labeled "Home" located at the bottom right corner.

## Left Dock (Application Launcher)
- **Top to Bottom**:
  - Google Chrome icon.
  - Thunderbird email client icon.
  - Visual Studio Code icon.
  - VLC media player icon.
  - LibreOffice Writer icon.
  - LibreOffice Calc icon.
  - LibreOffice Impress icon.
  - GIMP image editor icon.
  - Ubuntu Software icon.
  - Help icon (question mark).
  - Settings icon (gear).
  - Trash icon.
  - Grid icon for application overview.

## File Manager Window
- **Title**: "Home"
- **Left Sidebar**:
  - "Recent" section.
  - "Starred" section.
  - "Home" section (highlighted).
  - "Desktop" section.
  - "Documents" section.
  - "Downloads" section.
  - "Music" section.
  - "Pictures" section.
  - "Videos" section.
  - "Trash" section.
  - "Other Locations" section.
- **Main Content Area**:
  - Folder icons: "Desktop", "Documents", "server", "snap", ".cache", ".config", ".pki", ".profile", ".viminfo", ".vscode".
  - Navigation arrows for directory traversal.

## Settings Application Window
- **Title Bar**:
  - "Settings" text.
  - Minimize, maximize, and close buttons.
- **Left Sidebar**:
  - Search icon.
  - "Network" option.
  - "Bluetooth" option.
  - "Background" option.
  - "Appearance" option.
  - "Notifications" option.
  - "Search" option.
  - "Multitasking" option.
  - "Applications" option.
  - "Privacy" option.
  - "Online Accounts" option.
  - "Sharing" option.
  - "Sound" option.
  - "Power" option (highlighted in orange).
  - "Displays" option.
  - "Mouse & Touchpad" option.
  - "Keyboard" option.
  - "Printers" option.
- **Main Content Area**:
  - **Power Mode Section**:
    - Title: "Power Mode".
    - Description: "Affects system performance and power usage."
    - "Balanced" option (selected, with orange dot).
      - Description: "Standard performance and power usage."
    - "Power Saver" option.
      - Description: "Reduced performance and power usage."
  - **Power Saving Options Section**:
    - "Screen Blank" option.
      - Description: "Turns the screen off after a period of inactivity."
      - Dropdown menu set to "Never".
    - "Automatic Suspend" option.
      - Description: "Pauses the computer after a period of inactivity."
      - Status: "Off".

## Quick Settings Panel (Top Right)
- **Volume Control**:
  - Volume slider with orange indicator.
- **Network Status**:
  - "Wired Connected" with right arrow.
- **Power Mode**:
  - "Balanced" with right arrow.
- **Settings**:
  - "Settings" with gear icon.
- **Lock**:
  - "Lock" with lock icon.
- **Power Off / Log Out**:
  - "Power Off / Log Out" with right arrow.
